name: io.github.flow-steward/chargebee
title: Chargebee
description: Look up Chargebee customers, subscriptions, invoices and credit notes, or run your custom Chargebee…

site.description: Your Chargebee site name: the part before .chargebee.com in your Chargebee dashboard address (for example: acme)

server_slug.description: The MCP server to use: data_lookup_agent, knowledge_base_agent, onboarding_agent (test sites), or your custom server's slug shown in Settings > Configure Chargebee > Agentic AI > MCP Servers (for example: data_lookup_agent)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: An MCP API key created on the server's Access & Authentication tab (Settings > Configure Chargebee > Agentic AI > MCP Servers, turn on MCP Access, choose API key; up to 5 keys per server). Value: Bearer <api-key>. This is not the REST API Basic-auth key. Enter it as: Bearer <value>
